title: TriageResponse
description: POST /triage reply. The tier and rulesFired come only from shared/rules.json. The offline engine returns the same shape, so the UI has one result type.

rulesFired.description: Every rule that matched, in rules.json order. Empty means the default GREEN applied.

defaultApplied.description: Present only when rulesFired is empty: the default block from rules.json.

lowConfidence.description: Field names the extractor was unsure about, for the worker to confirm.

missingForSafety.description: Fields whose absence could hide a danger, e.g. ageMonths. The UI should ask for them before showing GREEN.

wheeze.description: Experimental supporting signal from breath audio. Never changes the tier on its own unless mapped into fields.wheeze for PED_RED_WHEEZE.
